name: events
description: Events between modules: a module declares what it emits (contributes.events.emits), others subscribe one of their tools, and each emit is delivered to the subscribers.

tools.name: emit
tools.description: Emit an event the caller declares in contributes.events.emits; delivered to each subscriber as { event, from, payload }.

event.description: The event's own name, without the module name

payload.description: JSON object matching the declared payload, at most 64 KiB

key.description: Idempotency key, derived from what happened

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Deliver <module>.<event> to one of the caller's own tools, which must be visible to modules and take event, from and payload (strings).

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Stop delivering <module>.<event> to the caller's tool.
